title: FIFA rankings: France finish the year on the podium, Morocco break into top five
summary: FIFA has unveiled its final world ranking of 2026. France remain third in the world, behind Spain and Argentina. Les Bleus finish in the top three for the ninth consecutive year. Morocco climb two places to fifth, equalling the best-ever ranking by an African nation, previously achieved by Nigeria in 1994. Brazil drop to seventh place, while Senegal remain…
